note: Single source of truth for the formal invariants map. Generated Markdown view is produced via scripts/verify/invariant-map.mjs --render; never edit docs/invariants.md by hand.
principles: Every invariant must have a unique id (no ranges, no 'ditto') so set differences remain computable.
Every entry must anchor to a real source file path so 'new logic minus registered invariants' is mathematically well-defined.
test must be a single file path containing at least one fc.assert property test.
